So the Q3 report mostly restates public numbers next to a stub trading at roughly three times its stated NAV, after +11% in five sessions. That gives a slight lean toward sell-the-news (p_up 45), offset by a small chance of the strategic update the board has flagged. abs_move 6 is this stub's own post-ex daily range, not the inflated 22% proxy, and findings sum to -0.3.

findings.finding: This is the first report since the payout. The stock at NOK 2.84 (market cap about NOK 266m on 93.5m shares) is roughly 3x the company's own estimate of retained cash, NOK 0.80-1.00/share (NOK 75-94m), plus inventory booked at USD 0.8m (about NOK 0.08/share) and 10% board warrants struck at NOK 1.00. The report will show that NAV in hard numbers after a +39% rebound from the 2.05 ex-date close and +11% in five sessions.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None. The name has never reported as a cash shell; its 12 prior results days as a drillship owner moved a median 1.29% and do not apply. Since ex-date the stub has moved a median ~4% a day, with +28% (10-12), +15% (10-26) and -7.8% (10-27).
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. The NOK 0.80-1.00 estimate has been public since 23 Sep and the stub was bid to 2.85 regardless, so the market is paying for optionality, not misreading cash. If a NAV restatement were fully discounted, the stock would not have rallied 11% into a report with no scheduled guidance. The run-up looks like positioning for news, and a print with only cash numbers disappoints that positioning.
findings.independence: The H1 2026 report independently gives inventory at USD 799,446: https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=679559. The audited 19 Sep parent balance in the EGM notice shows equity of USD 5.6m after the dividend provision (attachment to messageId=682898). Both documents are the company's own.

findings.finding: The board, paid only in 9.35m warrants struck at NOK 1.00, says it has 'received indications of interest within the marine industry' and is evaluating strategic alternatives and an active sale of the remaining inventory. The Q3 report is the first scheduled place an update can appear.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None. No strategic update has been issued since 23 Sep. The +28% day on 2026-10-12 and the +15% on 10-26 came with no company news, so the stub reprices on speculation alone.
findings.why_not_priced: The premium over NAV is largely this optionality, so it is mostly priced. What is not priced is whether the 29 Oct release names anything concrete. A named counterparty would reprice the stub far beyond ±6%, and nothing in the tape or filings shows one leaking. The only large-holder change is JPM crossing 5% and back within a day.
findings.independence: The warrant terms state the incentive is 'seeking and evaluating strategic opportunities ... including the realisation of the Group's remaining inventory': https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=684245 and EGM minutes messageId=683687. Same issuer, so this is not independent of the source.

baseline_tension: The sealed lean (+4.7, almost all of it the run-up component at +4.33) rests on run_up_20d_pct -86.6% and realised vol 352%. Both are the NOK 20.60 ex-dividend gap on 2026-10-08, not a price fall: the stub is +39% from its ex-date close and +11% over 5 days. My slight negative cuts against the lean but agrees with the 5-day free control, and the 22% event_move_proxy is likewise dividend-inflated, so I sized off the post-ex tape instead.
language_note: nothing the English sources did not already carry. Every DVD filing (sale, EGM notice, interim balance, dividend, warrants) is in English on NewsWeb; the EGM notice is bilingual and its Norwegian column matches the English.

Norwegian press (e24) shows the domestic retail framing: DVD featured in Investtech's 'tre sterke tradingaksjer' on 9 Oct, and the Hushovd and Tvenge families sold before the payout (22 Sep). lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0' and the core's 'lands inside what the company already guided': cut finding 1 (NAV restatement) from -1.5 to -0.8. The residual is the sell-the-news reminder against a +11% 5-day run, not the number itself.

'The move is in the guide' and 'understatement is the systematic error': kept abs_move_pct at 6.0, above the 3% pre-released base, because this stub's own post-ex daily range is that large and a strategic update is the guide-equivalent tail. p_up left at 45, inside the 45-55 band for a pre-released period.
